'''Her Majesty's Select Commandos''' were a [[Hapan]] [[Special forces/Legends|Special forces]] unit that served the [[Queen Mother]]; the only all male units in the Hapan military.<ref name="Invincible" />

Her Majesty's Select Commandos were of under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Livette]] to help protect the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] base on [[Shedu Maad]]. Livette then gave command of them to [[Taryn Zel]] to repel the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant's]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] led by [[Tahiri Veila]].<ref name="Invincible" />

The Commandos wore a special self-camouflaging armor that allowed the wearer to turn invisible. [[Trista Zel|Trista]] and Taryn Zel also wore this armor, allowing them to sneak by the perimeter guards. Trista's armor was of a [[Major/Legends|major]] and Taryn wore one with a officer's insignia.<ref name="Invincible" />
